title: Oxford Nanopore Rapid Barcoding with Normalization
author: Opentrons
materials: Pool all barcoded samples, noting the total volume.

steps.title: Prepare DNA input
steps.instruction: Transfer 50 ng genomic DNA per sample, adjust the volume to 9 µL with nuclease‑free water, and mix by pipetting.

steps.title: Add Rapid Barcodes
steps.instruction: Transfer 1 µL Rapid Barcode to each sample and mix by pipetting.

steps.title: Thermal incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at 30 °C for 2 minutes, then at 80 °C for 2 minutes, and finally cool to 4 °C on the temperature module.

steps.title: Pool barcoded samples
steps.instruction: Combine all barcoded samples into a single tube, noting the total volume.

steps.title: Prepare AMPure beads
steps.instruction: Vortex AMPure XP beads (AXP or SPRI) until fully resuspended, then add an equal volume of the resuspended beads to the pooled sample.

substeps.instruction: Add equal volume of beads to pooled sample

steps.title: Mix bead mixture
steps.instruction: Pipette the bead‑sample mixture continuously for 5 minutes at room temperature.
